PeriodFrequency.title: Period, recurrence and frequency
PeriodFrequency.statement: A wave period is the exact positive transition count closing one recurrence relative to a held clock recurrence; frequency is the exact count of closed recurrences per duration.
PeriodFrequency.generation_rule: Generate the complete carrier, recurrence/propagation relation, provenance, target-access, measurement-record, row, successor and extra-rule product.
PeriodFrequency.grammar_boundary: All finite wave forms constructed from generated recurrence, adjacent propagation, held phase/orientation, exact ratios and complete observation support without imported continuum equations.

choices.name: closed-recurrence-count-ratio
choices.reason: Only a closed recurrence with a held reference retains phase return, duration and exact frequency without an irrational cycle scalar.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: No rule beyond the admitted dependencies and forced relation is present.

PeriodFrequency.exact_result: Period and frequency are reciprocal exact positive recurrence ratios with complete phase and reference traces.
PeriodFrequency.induction_base: One recurrent source transition appears at one adjacent response cell with its source, phase and recurrence identity retained.
PeriodFrequency.induction_step: Appending one recurrence or propagation cell retains every earlier phase/response record and adds exactly one source-bound transition.
exclusions: ungenerated continuum or completed infinite wave
irrational or floating phase as a proof value
imported wave equation, fitted medium law or target-selected result
target access or omitted adverse row
operational_witnesses: A finite recurrence returns to the named source state after a positive transition count.
Held traversal order distinguishes opposite phase progress with the same positive support.

target_rows.source_locator: NIST ASD spectral lines carry frequencies/wavenumbers
NIST ASD energy-level transitions define recurrent spectral distinctions

PeriodFrequency.falsification_condition: The wave law is falsified if any committed NIST spectral/transition row lacks the predicted recurrence or propagation structure, a row is omitted, or the tampered row is accepted.
